# Certificate Manager

Issue or import local certificates and exercise certificate lifecycle APIs.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#certificate-manager) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No DNS/email validation wait, Private CA, renewal or ACME.
- Only exportable certificates retain private keys.
- Certificates are local CA certificates, not publicly trusted.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
